title: Fact-Checkers Debunk Fake Newspaper Front Page Falsely Claiming Tinubu Admitted Drug Abuse
detail: Fact-checkers have identified a disinformation campaign using a fabricated newspaper front page falsely claiming Nigerian President Bola Tinubu admitted to drug abuse and trafficking. The forged front page was circulated widely on social media and has been flagged as deliberately misleading.

media.caption: Fact-checkers flag fake newspaper front page falsely claiming Tinubu admitted drug abuse
